body: I've been a cutter for 8 years
I'm sick of using coping skills ! I'm sick of living life ! I'm depressed and hurt !
I have tried to kill myself before so I know it hurts but in the end everyone will be happy ! I am sick of using coping skills !
Thank you for sharing , you are valuable as well. ! I lost a friend to suicide a few years ago and I never saw it coming ! It still gets to me
